summary: Bays on a campus road with parked cars, no homes, trees behind.
reasons: Cars parked along east kerb at start
Trees and bays beside the kerb

best_section.where: east kerb at the southern end, beside the angled bays off the road from the main street

drivers.seclusion: No dwellings anywhere; university buildings 14 m or more away at the start, with trees on the east side.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed campus road with a row of cars already in bays along the east side, so a van fits in line.
drivers.traffic: Low vehicle traffic on a dead-end campus spur; pedestrians pass by day.
drivers.convention: Several cars park along this kerb, so a van will not stand out.

flags: Steep: about 6% over the best section
Bollards mapped 8 m and 10 m from the kerb
Campus parking permits and security cannot be seen
sun_shade: Trees shade the east side; tall buildings shade the road from the west in the afternoon.
